---

**What's the topic?**
Name of the tool, concept, protocol, or use case you're suggesting.

**What category does it fit?**
- [ ] Tool — a specific product or software
- [ ] Concept — an idea or approach
- [ ] Protocol — a process or standard
- [ ] Use Case — a real-world application scenario

**Why does it belong on the Hot Topics page?**
Why is this relevant or trending in accessibility/AI right now?

**Link to a resource**
Where should the card link to? (existing doc, external URL, or "needs a new page")

**Anything else?**
Context, examples, or related topics on the site.
